dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures visible across the lateral flank; perimeters consist of irregular, low-intensity pixel boundaries with a soft gradient transition into high-intensity, sandy-colored interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical dark pixel clusters localized in the neck and lower lateral regions; clusters lack internal gradients and appear as solid, low-intensity points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-flank form an obtuse triangle; a secondary chain of high-intensity blobs forms a curvilinear path along the lower lateral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark 'V' shaped marking located on the dorsal-nuchal midline; high specular highlights on the cranial and dorsal ridge caused by directional lighting.
